title: Downtown San Francisco Architecture & Public Art Tour
blurb: Explore San Francisco’s Central Business District on a 2.5 hour walking tour that showcases its stunning architecture, captivating public art, and vibrant public spaces. Discover the diverse architectural styles from historic buildings like the London Paris National Bank to sleek glass towers like the JP Morgan Chase Building. Learn about the city’s commitment to public art, with works by artists such as George Rickey, Jenny Holzer, and Frank Stella. Experience urban oases like plazas and parks, including Salesforce Park with its 5½ acres of greenery and spectacular views. End at the entrance of the San Francisco Museum of Modern Art (SFMOMA). Perfect for architecture and art enthusiasts, this tour offers a fresh perspective on the city’s dynamic landscape. Recently featured on the 99% Invisible podcast.
